The data spell every [k] as g: an’stawteg [tek], epsaqtejg [ck] and ge’gwising [nk]. A word-final [k] is therefore written g, never k, so the submitted spelling is wrong on that letter.

The apostrophe before it is plausible. In the data, a schwa before an obstruent is written with an apostrophe (an’stawteg [nəs], g’p’ta’q [gəb, bəd]). A schwa before a sonorant is left unwritten (tmi’gn, e’jnt, tlatl). In [alaptək] the schwa precedes the obstruent [k], so it is written, giving alapt’g.
